Long-stay signals (five-test check): monthly $595 plus metered electric, a 3-month special, 'Rent Due Day' late fees and a background-check policy for long-term leases. Daily RV sites are still sold with club discounts 'valid for daily RV sites Only', so nightly stays look genuinely for sale.
